sources.title: Sample newsletter: website chat for small businesses

sources.title: Sample newsletter: the follow-up gap
sources.excerpt: SAMPLE EXCERPT. Many inquiries never get a second message. A short routine helps: answer the same day, send a reminder after two days, and log every contact in one place.
